import numpy as np
from numpy.linalg import cond

def record(name, x):
    # probe runtime will capture each probe(...) call as structured values
    probe(name, x)

A64 = np.array([[1.,0,1],[0,-2.,0],[0,0,3.]], dtype=np.cdouble)
A32 = np.array([[1.,0,1],[0,-2.,0],[0,0,3.]], dtype=np.csingle)

x1 = cond(A64, p='fro')
# record dtype and value (value should be real)
record('ex1_dtype', str(np.asarray(x1).dtype))
record('ex1_value', np.asarray(x1).item())

x2 = cond(A32, p=np.inf)
record('ex2_dtype', str(np.asarray(x2).dtype))
record('ex2_value', np.asarray(x2).item())

Ainf = (np.array([[1.,0,1],[0,-2.,0],[0,0,3.]], dtype=np.cdouble)) * (1+1j)
x3 = cond(Ainf, p=np.inf)
record('ex3_dtype', str(np.asarray(x3).dtype))
record('ex3_value', np.asarray(x3).item())

import numpy as np
import numpy.linalg as linalg

def rec(x, name):
    # x may be scalar or 0-d array; normalize
    arr = np.asarray(x)
    rec_dtype = arr.dtype
    rec_value = arr.item() if arr.shape == () else arr
    return rec_dtype, rec_value

A_f = np.array([[1., 0, 1],[0, -2., 0],[0, 0, 3.]], dtype=np.cdouble)
A_s = np.array([[1., 0, 1],[0, -2., 0],[0, 0, 3.]], dtype=np.csingle)
A_m = (np.array([[1., 0, 1],[0, -2., 0],[0, 0, 3.]], dtype=np.float64) * (1 + 1j)).astype(np.complex128)

out1 = linalg.cond(A_f, p='fro')
out1_d, out1_v = rec(out1, 'out1')

out2 = linalg.cond(A_s, p=np.inf)
out2_d, out2_v = rec(out2, 'out2')

out3 = linalg.cond(A_m, p=np.inf)
out3_d, out3_v = rec(out3, 'out3')

# record as plain Python objects so the harness captures them
probe('out1_dtype', str(out1_d))
probe('out1_value', float(np.real_if_close(out1_v)))
probe('out2_dtype', str(out2_d))
probe('out2_value', float(np.real_if_close(out2_v)))
probe('out3_dtype', str(out3_d))
probe('out3_value', float(np.real_if_close(out3_v)))
